stations.title: Order page
stations.note: A request nobody meant it to take.

stations.title: Old server
stations.text: An if for every address, method unread.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, a request asks the order server to delete the price list.
The old server never reads the method, so it answers as if all went well.
You write a router with a table of routes and two ways to say no, in three tasks.
Now the request gets a plain no that says which methods the price list takes.
Same order page, same shop, and a server Hesper can read route by route.
